name: snapmark-monorepo
description: Snapmark: the Mac app, the Chrome extension and the website

scripts.test: npm test -w snapmark-app && vitest run tests/sdlc.test.ts && bash scripts/test_ci_changes.sh
scripts.perf: npm run build && python3 scripts/fitness.py perf
scripts.fitness: npm run build && python3 scripts/fitness.py all
scripts.sdlc:tools: curl -fsSL https://plannotator.ai/install.sh | bash && claude plugin marketplace add backnotprop/plannotator && claude plugin install plannotator@plannotator && npx skills add backnotprop/plannotator/apps/skills/extra --global --skill plannotator-setup-goal --agent claude-code --yes

author: Calvin Dudek
